title:
Blue Pits Annual General Meeting 2025 📆 

29.10.2025

An annual general meeting (AGM) for a charity is a yearly meeting where members can hear a report on the past year's activities, review the financial accounts, and elect trustees. 

It is a formal opportunity for members to hold the governing body accountable and provides a legal and/or constitutional requirement for many charities. The charity's governing document will specify the exact rules for holding the AGM, such as when to hold it and how much notice to give.
